title: Battle of Camperdown
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Battle of Camperdown", at revision 1378738547, opens: "The Battle of Camperdown was fought on 11 October 1797 between the Royal Navy's North Sea Fleet under Admiral of the Blue Adam Duncan and a Batavian Navy fleet led by Vice-admiral Jan Willem de Winter. Duncan's fleet won a complete victory over de Winter's in what was the most significant engagement between British and Batavian forces during the French Revolutionary Wars, capturing eleven ships without losing any of their own." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q577081, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1797 major naval action of the French Revolutionary Wars". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
